scenes.title: BLACK HOLES CAN DIE
scenes.say: Black holes aren't forever. They slowly evaporate. How?

scenes.title: Empty space isn't empty
scenes.say: Empty space keeps making particle pairs right at the edge. One falls in. One escapes.

scenes.title: Every escape steals a little mass
scenes.say: Each escape steals a little mass, so the hole shrinks. A sun-sized one needs ten to the sixty-seven years.

scenes.title: Today they still grow
scenes.say: Right now they're colder than space, so they take in more than they give off.

scenes.title: WHAT HAPPENS TO THE STUFF INSIDE?
scenes.next: PART 5: Where does it all go?
scenes.say: Is the stuff inside gone, or saved? Comment which. Part five: where does it all go?
